description: Detached-target DQN Huber penalty for same-shaped floating predictions and TD targets, with rho_delta(e)=0.5*e^2 for |e|<=delta and delta*(|e|-0.5*delta) otherwise. The default delta=1 matches the clipped TD error described by Mnih et al. (2015), Nature 518, Methods § ‘Training algorithm for deep Q-networks’ (https://doi.org/10.1038/nature14236); Huber scaling follows the PyTorch HuberLoss formula (https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.nn.modules.loss.HuberLoss.html). Target detachment mirrors src/topologies/training/recipes/value_learning.py:34-38; Bellman target construction and action selection remain caller-owned.

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
    features = torch.randn(6, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    return {"inputs": synth.Tensor(features), "targets": synth.Tensor(features[:1])}
ds = synth.Spec("dqn-huber-regression", generator=samples, size=12, splits={"train": 1.0}, seed=7, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = ds.for_recipe("regression", split="train", input_field="inputs", target_field="targets", preserve_shape=True)
model = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=6, out_features=1)
trainer = Trainer(model, train, recipe="regression", recipe_config={"loss": "dqn-huber"}, batch_size=4, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
examples.title: Train a value regressor with DQN Huber loss

name: DQN Huber TD loss

parameters.additional parameters: **params accepts delta only; unsupported keys raise ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because regression targets are not indexed classes
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point prediction tensor with any nonempty shape
parameters.reduction: none returns elementwise penalties, mean averages all elements, or sum totals them (default mean)
parameters.targets: floating-point tensor with the same shape, dtype, and device as the prediction; detached before residual calculation
